name: Security scan findings
description: Findings from whatever scanner the build already ran, read from the report it left behind and normalized into one shape, whether the tool was a SAST, an SCA, a secret detector or an infrastructure scanner.

reports.description: Comma separated globs matched against every file in the working directory and against bare file names, naming the scanner reports to read.

maxFindings.description: Maximum number of findings to carry in the facts. The counts still include findings that are dropped.

facts.source: `report` when a scanner report was read, `none` when there was none.
facts.reason: Why nothing was read, present only when `source` is `none`.
facts.reports: Every report that was read, in path order.
facts.reports[].path: Path of the report, relative to the directory the CLI runs in.
facts.reports[].modified: When the report was last written, in ISO 8601, so you can spot a stale report.
facts.reports[].format: Format it was read as: `sarif`, `trivy`, `grype` or `osv`.
facts.reports[].producer.name: Scanner that wrote it, as the report names itself, or `null` when it names none.
facts.reports[].producer.version: Version of that scanner, or `null` when the report carries none.
facts.reports[].findings: How many findings that report carried.
facts.counts.total: Findings across every report that was read.
facts.counts.unknown: Findings the scanner gave no severity, or a severity that is not recognised.
facts.kinds.sast: Findings about the repository's own code.
facts.kinds.secret: Findings about a credential in the tree.
facts.kinds.unknown: Findings that could not be classified.
facts.findings[].id: Rule or vulnerability identifier the scanner gave it.
facts.findings[].message: What the scanner said, truncated to 500 characters.
facts.findings[].path: File it was found in, relative to the working directory, or `null`.
facts.findings[].line: Line it was found on, or `null`.
facts.findings[].package.name: Dependency it is about, present only for a finding about one.
facts.findings[].identifiers: Every CVE, GHSA or other identifier the scanner attached.
facts.findings[].fixedIn: Version that fixes it, or `null` when the scanner names none.
facts.findings[].fingerprint: Stable identity of the finding across runs, so the same finding is recognisable in a later build.
facts.dropped: Findings left out because `maxFindings` was reached.
